documents.content: HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause.
documents.query: async order 200 vs 202 contract callback notification

args.reason: User's lead hinges on the 200/202 contract; retrieving active integration method before inspecting order/delivery facts.
Knowledge confirms 200 only means read succeeded; first establish current order lifecycle state before assessing callback.
Order is COMPLETED at version 2, so I need the current callback event and actual transport acknowledgement/failure before judging the missing notification.

args.reason: Delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED via receiver HTTP 202, which only confirms transport acceptance; need current receiver processing state to see if the callback was actually processed.
